question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Jane Eyre, Bob gets Hamlet, Claire gets Dune, Dave gets Dracula, and Eve gets Ivanhoe.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Claire and Dave swap books. Then, Claire and Eve swap books. Then, Bob and Dave swap books. Finally, Alice and Claire swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Jane Eyre
(B) Hamlet
(C) Dune
(D) Dracula
(E) Ivanhoe
solution:
Book order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Dune | Dracula | Ivanhoe
1. Claire and Bob swap: Jane Eyre | Dune | Hamlet | Dracula | Ivanhoe
2. Claire and Dave swap: Jane Eyre | Dune | Dracula | Hamlet | Ivanhoe
3. Claire and Eve swap: Jane Eyre | Dune | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | Dracula
4. Bob and Dave swap: Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | Dune | Dracula
5. Alice and Claire swap: Ivanhoe | Hamlet | Jane Eyre | Dune | Dracula
Claire has Jane Eyre, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
